title: Ebuteli Fellowship, sixth edition (Kinshasa research institute)
organization: Ebuteli, Congolese research institute on politics, governance and violence (Kinshasa)
overview: Six-month research fellowship at Ebuteli, a Kinshasa-based Congolese institute researching politics, governance and violence. Each fellow joins the team, works with a mentor under one of three research pillars (national politics, economic governance, armed violence) and may publish blog posts, analysis notes, reports or podcasts. The institute takes six fellows a year, three per semester. The sixth edition is planned to start in November 2026.
program_dates: Six months, starting in November 2026 (sixth edition). Based mainly in Kinshasa, with possible research missions elsewhere in the country.
deadline_text: 'jusqu'au vendredi 30 octobre 2026 à 23h59 (heure de Kinshasa)'. The call is dated 19 October 2026.
funding_details: 'Allocation financière : chaque fellow reçoit une allocation financière pour couvrir les frais liés à la participation au programme.' The amount is not stated
No application fee is mentioned in the call
stipend: Financial allowance for each fellow; amount not stated
eligibility: Citizen of the DRC
Aged 18 to 30
At least a university degree in a field of study relevant to Ebuteli's research
Strong interest in current developments in politics and civil society
Fluent spoken French and correct written French
Submit a research-project concept note that is distinct from any work done for studies
Demonstrated interest in research; analytical skills on the political, economic or security dynamics of the country
Able to work in a team
Available full-time to start the sixth edition, planned for November 2026
Assets (not mandatory): English, intellectual curiosity and creativity, journalism or communication skills
nationality_requirements: Citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo

title: EU Delegation to the DRC: subsidised internship for young graduates (Political, Press and Information section)
organization: Delegation of the European Union to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (EEAS), Kinshasa
overview: Subsidised internships of up to six months for young graduates in the Political, Press and Information section of the EU Delegation in Kinshasa. The section follows diplomatic relations between the EU and the DRC and makes the EU's actions in support of the country's development known. Calls appear on the EEAS website at irregular intervals and stay open 9 to 16 days. The latest call, for two internships in 2026 with provisional starts in March and October, closed on 25 January 2026.
program_dates: Up to six months. Provisional starts in the calls read: May 2023, November 2024, and March and October 2026.
deadline_text: No call is open. Latest call: published 15.01.2026, 'Délai pour l'envoi des candidatures : 25 janvier 2026.'
expected_next_cycle: Irregular. Three calls are on the EEAS site: published 15.03.2023 (deadline 31/03/2023), 17.09.2024 (deadline 26 September 2024) and 15.01.2026 (deadline 25 January 2026), each open 9 to 16 days. No later call was found on 29 October 2026.

title: Wageningen University Africa Scholarship Programme (ASP), MSc 2027-28
overview: The Africa Scholarship Programme offers talented and motivated students from Africa the chance to do a master's degree at Wageningen University. The scholarship covers travel to and from the Netherlands, a living allowance, tuition fees, and visa and health-insurance costs for the 24 months of the programme. Recipients are chosen by lottery among applicants who submitted a complete MSc application before 1 December 2026 and meet every requirement.
